_comment: V-BASELINE-0 camera preset registry. Each preset names a (mission, warmup_s, description) tuple. The 'camera preset' identity is the deterministic state mc2.exe lands in under MC2_SMOKE_MODE=1 + MC2_SMOKE_SEED=0xC0FFEE after `warmup_s` seconds of passive mission load. No in-engine preset hook exists yet; this is the lightweight contract: same mission + same seed + same warmup = same frame.

staticprop_baseline_01.description: StaticPropOpaque-heavy urban scene. tier1 mc2_24 standard load, post-stabilize frame. Use for static-prop pipeline visual regression.

staticprop_baseline_02.description: StaticPropOpaque mid-density scene. tier1 mc2_10 standard load, post-stabilize frame. Complements baseline_01 with different terrain + prop distribution.

terrain_grass_01.description: TERRAIN-BASELINE-0: terrain-heavy grass/desert scene (tier1 mc2_01). Primary preset for terrain visual regression — exercises grass + dirt + rock material classification and POM. Pairs with --terrain-debug-mode for shader-mode captures.

terrain_salvage_03.description: TERRAIN-BASELINE-0: terrain-heavy salvage scene (tier1 mc2_03). Complements grass_01 with heavier rock + cement-overlay coverage.

terrain_combined_17.description: TERRAIN-BASELINE-0: terrain-heavy combined-arms scene (tier1 mc2_17). Late-campaign mission with mixed biomes; stresses material-weight blends and shadow PCF across varied slope.

terrain_final_24.description: TERRAIN-LIGHTING-SOAK-2: terrain-heavy final-campaign scene (tier1 mc2_24). Steepest tier1 terrain (slope p99=51°, max range -100..1400 wu per slice-3 audit); the canonical worst-case for V2 shadow-aware fill validation.

mech_24.description: MECH-BASELINE-0: active-mech scene (tier1 mc2_24). Primary preset for mech-lane visual regression — mech material inventory confirms a Mad Cat (data/tgl/128/madcatrgb.tga) is submitted at this seed/warmup. Pair with --mech-debug-mode for the registry-backed mech debug views (0 Final, 2 Albedo, 3 LightingOnly, 4 Normal); the sidecar embeds the live mech inventory.

mech_17.description: MECH-BASELINE-0: active-mech combined-arms scene (tier1 mc2_17). Complements mech_24 with a different mission's mech roster. Use --mech-debug-mode + the embedded sidecar inventory to confirm which mech textures/materialIdx were on screen.

water_final_24.description: WATER-BASELINE-0: PRIMARY water preset (tier1 mc2_24). Water is armed on the GPU-driven/MDI path immediately on load (no cinematic gate), so the MDI water FS — the one that owns --water-debug-mode (MC2_WATER_DEBUG_MODE) — renders at this seed/warmup. Pair with --water-debug-mode for the FS material-space debug views (1 Tint, 2 Alpha, 3 Normal, 4 Depth, 5 Shore, 6 Lighting); --water-debug-mode also forces MC2_GPU_DRIVEN_WATER=1.

water_heavy_01.description: WATER-BASELINE-0: large-water-surface scene (tier1 mc2_01). Heaviest visible water of tier1, but the ~20s cinematic intro must finish first — warmup_s=28 clears it. Secondary/complement to water_final_24. Same --water-debug-mode usage.
